None of my tools can read the current value from the FleetModel connection, and you asked me to keep the same semantic model. If I filled in a name myself, I could silently point the connection at a different model.

If you tell me the current semantic model name, I'll make the change with workspace `FleetAnalytics-Prod`, the dataset name you give, and Windows integrated security (the default). I'll leave LegacySQL and ScratchPowerQuery untouched.
